constraints.name: fund_transactions_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((transaction_type = 'Transfer'::text) AND (account IS NULL) AND (direction IS NULL) AND (from_account IS NOT NULL) AND (to_account IS NOT NULL) AND (from_account <> to_account)) OR ((transaction_type <> 'Transfer'::text) AND (account IS NOT NULL) AND (direction IS NOT NULL) AND (from_account IS NULL) AND (to_account IS NULL))))

constraints.name: fund_transactions_transaction_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((transaction_type = ANY (ARRAY['Opening Balance'::text, 'Money In'::text, 'Money Out'::text, 'GrabFood Settlement'::text, 'Adjustment'::text, 'Transfer'::text])))

policies.name: hibi_app_data_insert
policies.check: (((key = ANY (ARRAY['hibi-menu'::text, 'hibi-addons'::text])) AND hibi_has_permission('menu'::text)) OR ((key = 'hibi-settings'::text) AND hibi_has_permission('settings'::text)))

policies.name: hibi_app_data_update
policies.check: (((key = ANY (ARRAY['hibi-menu'::text, 'hibi-addons'::text])) AND hibi_has_permission('menu'::text)) OR ((key = 'hibi-settings'::text) AND hibi_has_permission('settings'::text)))
policies.using: (((key = ANY (ARRAY['hibi-menu'::text, 'hibi-addons'::text])) AND hibi_has_permission('menu'::text)) OR ((key = 'hibi-settings'::text) AND hibi_has_permission('settings'::text)))

policies.name: authenticated_reconciliation_snapshot_insert
policies.check:
((snapshot_type = 'reconciliation'::text) AND (created_by = auth.uid()) AND hibi_has_permission('reports'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eod_reconciliations e
  WHERE ((e.business_date = fund_balance_snapshots.business_date) AND (e.locked = true) AND (e.reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)))))
